description: This is a shell script responsible for managing the startup and configuration of an advanced security module in a device, including enabling/disabling features, restarting services, and handling firewall rules.

methods.name: start_device_services
methods.description: Initializes and starts device services based on the provided argument, handling various feature toggles and service startups.

methods.name: stop_agent_services
methods.description: Stops all agent-related services and cleans up firewall rules and configurations.

methods.name: start_advsec_safe_browsing
methods.description: Enables and starts the safe browsing feature.

methods.name: stop_advsec_safe_browsing
methods.description: Disables safe browsing and cleans up related files.

methods.name: start_advsec_softflowd
methods.description: Enables and starts the softflowd feature.

methods.name: start_advanced_security
methods.description: Handles starting or stopping specific security features based on parameters.

methods.name: advanced_parental_control_setup
methods.description: Activates or deactivates parental control feature.

methods.name: privacy_protection_setup
methods.description: Activates or deactivates privacy protection feature.

methods.name: enable_icmpv6
methods.description: Enables ICMPv6 support by creating the relevant marker file.

methods.name: disable_icmpv6
methods.description: Disables ICMPv6 support by removing the relevant marker file.

methods.name: enable_userspace
methods.description: Enables user-space features, including kernel module reloading.

methods.name: disable_userspace
methods.description: Disables user-space features and cleans related files.

methods.name: enable_agent
methods.description: Enables the agent via creating marker files.

methods.name: do_firewall_restart
methods.description: Restarts firewall rules based on current configuration.
